checks.text: Failed logins for an email address with no account lock that address after 5 attempts, as they do for an existing account.
When every counter-store call fails, a login with the correct password is still refused.
Failures for one email address from 5 different client addresses lock that email address, and failures for one email address never lock another.
A successful login clears the failed attempts for that email address: after a success, 4 more failures do not lock it, and a 5th does.
Before any lockout, an unknown email and a wrong password get the same result from authenticate_user, and the router answers both with the same 401.
Each failed attempt restarts the 15-minute window: 5 failures 10 minutes apart lock the email address.
The router answers AccountLockedError with 429 and a Retry-After header.
